title: Teaching datasets
description: Tiny fixed datasets used for hand calculations in lessons and interactive widgets, so the same numbers can be reproduced in SAS, R and Python.

datasets.name: KM12
datasets.label: Twelve-subject survival dataset for Kaplan–Meier by hand
datasets.description: Twelve subjects with follow-up times in months. Includes a tie between an event and a censoring at month 6, so the convention that events precede censorings at the same time can be demonstrated. Kaplan–Meier median = 11 months.

columns.name: EVENT
columns.label: Event indicator (1 = event, 0 = censored)
columns.notes: Note that ADaM ADTTE uses CNSR with the opposite convention (0 = event).
